SELECT 
    `p`.`name`,
    SUM(`o`.`pay_amount`) AS `total_pay_amount`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `o`.`id`) AS `paid_order_count`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `r`.`refund_status` = 'SUCCESS' THEN `o`.`id` END) AS `refunded_order_count`
FROM `trd_order` AS `o`
LEFT JOIN `trd_refund` AS `r` ON `o`.`id` = `r`.`order_id`
LEFT JOIN `dim_shop` AS `s` ON `o`.`shop_id` = `s`.`id`
LEFT JOIN `dim_platform` AS `p` ON `s`.`platform_id` = `p`.`id`
WHERE `o`.`created_at` >= '2026-02-01' AND `o`.`created_at` < '2026-03-01'
    AND `o`.`order_status` IN ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')
GROUP BY `p`.`name`;
